priceType: indicative starting fee; final quote required

booking.instructions: Use the public inquiry form for consent and selected offer; no instant checkout.

offers.name: LocaleReady Audit
offers.scope: One web application, one repository, up to 10 representative screens and two target locales.
offers.deliverable: Prioritized i18n findings, pseudo-localization and RTL checks, remediation roadmap.
offers.acceptance: Reproducible findings with severity, affected surface and proposed fix.
offers.outcome: Know what must change before entering a new market.

offers.name: LanguageBench
offers.scope: One text AI workflow, two target languages, up to 50 agreed test cases.
offers.deliverable: Evaluation dataset, reproducible scoring harness, quality baseline and failure analysis.
offers.acceptance: Run results by locale and documented scoring rubric.
offers.exclusions: Native-linguist validation, retraining and third-party usage charges.
offers.outcome: Find where AI quality drops across languages.

offers.name: LocOps Connect
offers.scope: One repository, one supported TMS or translation API, one CI workflow.
offers.deliverable: Working integration, terminology checks, error handling and runbook.
offers.acceptance: A test change flows through the agreed integration with recorded result.
offers.exclusions: TMS licenses, translation fees and additional integrations.
offers.outcome: Replace repetitive localization handoffs with a tested pipeline.

offers.name: Global AI Pilot
offers.scope: One text assistant or search workflow, one data source and two locales.
offers.deliverable: Multilingual prototype, retrieval and evaluation baseline, deployment handoff.
offers.acceptance: Agreed test questions executed in both locales with documented results.
offers.exclusions: Production SLA, dataset licensing and custom model training.
offers.outcome: Validate a multilingual AI experience before scaling.

offers.name: Applied AI Build
offers.scope: One bounded AI use case, one model provider and one data source.
offers.deliverable: Working application integration, tests and deployment instructions.
offers.acceptance: Demonstrated agreed use case with recorded test results.
offers.exclusions: Model training, ongoing hosting and additional workflows.
offers.outcome: Turn a defined AI use case into working software.

offers.name: Agent Workflow Pilot
offers.scope: One workflow with up to two authorized tool integrations.
offers.deliverable: Agent execution path, scoped permissions, failure handling and acceptance tests.
offers.acceptance: Successful test execution with trace and controlled failure case.
offers.exclusions: Unbounded autonomy, enterprise SLAs and additional connectors.
offers.outcome: Connect AI to an actual operational task.

offers.name: InferenceTune
offers.buyer: ML infrastructure and AI application teams
offers.scope: One model workload and one agreed target hardware or hosting environment.
offers.deliverable: Baseline latency, memory and cost metrics; tuned configuration and reproducible comparison.
offers.acceptance: Repeatable before-and-after measurement under the same workload.
offers.exclusions: Hardware, provider charges and guaranteed performance gains.
offers.outcome: Identify practical cost and performance improvements.
